name: The Brokering of Peace
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Your deeds go beyond the tale of a simple hero, adventurer.  If you are a representative of your people, then your people are ones we would work to make peace with.

Please - take this offering to the dwarven king that resides in a mountain of iron; I believe you call this city Ironforge.  In times past, he had tried to make contact with us on behalf of his Alliance.  It is now only fitting to acknowledge you as the key in your Alliance's efforts in brokering peace.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Timbermaw Offering of Peace to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Indeed, this is a most fortuitous turn of events.  Were a lasting peace to be made with these creatures, this would certainly give us an advantage in the affairs of Kalimdor... one that the Night Elves cannot support on their own.  I will notify the other leaders of the Alliance of this immediately, and further diplomats will be dispatched!

As for you, adventurer... you have shown courage in both diplomacy and in action.  I thank you, as does the whole of the Alliance.
narrative.requestItemsText: Champion, you are welcomed in my domain.  Ironforge should always be considered a home to a hero such as yourself.  Now, what business do you have with me?
